column1: # The date each onset figure's x axis is anchored to, read off the printed
# tick labels by a human against saved crops. This is the one manual input
# the onset reader takes, and it exists because the alternative -- inferring
# the axis dates from the report's own date -- is the defect the design
# note names: the printed tick is sometimes days short of the report date,
# and it freezes across re-published reports (12 jul serves reports 059-062;
# 15 Jul serves 064-067) while report dates advance. Nothing may derive an
# onset date from a sitrep date.
# One row per distinct decoded image (reprints share their row through the
# hash). `first_label` and `last_label` are the leftmost and rightmost
# *labelled* ticks, verbatim as printed -- the locale flips between French
# and English across render families, and some renders end with an
# unlabelled tick beyond the last label (087, 102), which is why the last
# label is recorded rather than the last tick.
# Machine-checked at build time, so a wrong row cannot survive: every
# detected tick must sit a whole number of weeks from the first; the span
# first_date..last_date must equal a whole number of weeks that fits the
# detected tick count; and consecutive vintages must align at zero shift
# under the cross-vintage L1 test. A row failing any check refuses its
# ONE HASH MUST NEVER GET A ROW HERE: 3eb931c88df2, sitrep 110, published
# 2026-09-01. That figure is titled "Nombre des cas confirmes par date de
# NOTIFICATION"; every figure below is "par date de debut des symptomes".
# separates the two families on fill colour and the source restyled its
# notification chart into the onset chart's palette (dark blue 0.0067 against
# a 0.05 threshold). The vintage is refused today only because this file has
# no row for it, and the refusal register in `tests/test_onset.py` describes
# missing rows as a backlog to clear -- so adding one here in good faith would
# read notification-dated counts into the onset series, which is the exact
# defect `identify.py` was written to prevent. Adding a row for this hash is
# not the fix; a discriminator that does not rest on a colour the source
# sha12       first 12 hex of the decoded-pixel SHA-256, the image identity
# image_file  the published copy under data/build/onset/images/
# first_label the leftmost labelled tick, exactly as printed
# first_date  that label as an ISO date
# last_label  the rightmost labelled tick, exactly as printed
# last_date   that label as an ISO date
